chunks.content: 96 The BOI Reporting Saga Continues—Here’s What You Need to Know This Time Hi Sara, Just when you thought the Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) reporting requirement might fade into the background, it’s back—and yes, it’s here to stay. The courts have officially given the green light, which means business owners (yes, that includes you-and me SIGH) must report their ownership details to the federal government. The government has graciously extended the deadline by 30 days—a rare bureaucratic gift. There’s even talk of further adjustments to ease the burden on small businesses. But for now, here’s what you need to know: ✅ New deadline: March 21st for initial, updated, and corrected BOI reports. ✅ Cost to file? Zero. Reporting is completely free on the FinCEN website. ✅ Who has to report? Pretty much all LLCs and corporations, with a few exceptions (like certain nonprofits or some entities not created by a filing with the secretary of state). If this is news to you, don’t panic—but don’t ignore it either. Non-compliance could lead to fines, and no one needs that kind of surprise expense. Got questions? Whether it’s BOI or another tax-related matter, I’m happy to help. Just hit reply, and let’s make sure your business stays compliant. To smarter deals, Sara Sharp Partner, SK&S Law Group Business Consultant & Founder, Deal Academy P.S. Know a business owner who might need this reminder?
